tasks.label: Biddyan: run latest Flutter web
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-Process dart,dartaotruntime -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}\frontend'; flutter run -d web-server --web-port 8080

tasks.label: Biddyan: run fast release web
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-Process dart,dartaotruntime -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}\frontend'; flutter run -d web-server --release --web-port 8080
